name: Asparagus and Caper Hollandaise Tart
subtitle: A crisp savory tart with tender asparagus and tangy herb-flecked sauce.
description: A baked pastry tart layered with asparagus and finished with caper-parsley hollandaise and fresh rocket.

ingredients.item: vinegar such as sherry or white wine
plain flour plus extra for dusting
egg yolk (freeze the white for another recipe)

instructions.text: Rub the cold butter into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add the egg yolk and bring the mixture together into a dough.
Shape the dough into a flat disk, wrap it, and chill for 30 minutes.
Roll the dough on a lightly floured surface and use it to line a tart pan. Trim the edges and chill while preparing the filling.
Cut the asparagus into suitable tart-length pieces. Boil it for 1 minute, then drain and cool for 15 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 400°F. Line the pastry with parchment and weights, then bake for 20 minutes. Remove the weights and bake for 10 minutes more.
Beat the eggs and pour them into the pastry shell. Arrange the cooled asparagus over the surface and bake until the center is fully set and reaches 160°F.
Melt the butter gently. Blend the vinegar, mace, and egg yolk, then gradually incorporate the melted butter until thick and smooth.
Whisk the sauce until it holds stiff peaks, then fold in the drained capers and chopped parsley.
Cool the tart for 15 minutes, then top with the hollandaise and rocket before serving.
